header: A full-width section for the recommended plan
subheader: Wider than a card, so there is room to explain why this plan fits.
bodytext: The rich text explains the plan in a paragraph or two: who it is for and what happens when they outgrow it. A card only has room for one sentence.
note: The note holds the conditions, such as tax, term and what counts as a seat.

features.title: The pitch sits beside the offer
features.text: The argument on one side, the price and the buttons on the other.

features.title: One raised card for the decision
features.text: Badge, price, period, buttons and conditions stay together.

features.title: Entitlements run underneath
features.text: The list reads down each column, then across.

features.title: A value at the end of a row
features.text: For a quantity or a limit, such as storage or seats.

features.title: The photograph drops out on phones
features.text: So the price is on screen without scrolling past it.

features.title: Two spotlights on one page
features.text: Two recommended plans cancel each other out.

image.alternative: A laptop beside a seedling and gardening gloves shows a weekly shift plan with coloured shifts.
